reviews.author: Thai Nguyen
reviews.text: My wife Keri and I turned to Sunflower today when we faced a clogged drain. I called them late in the evening, and they responded the very next morning, arriving promptly. They took the time to explain everything clearly, and their prices were fair. We truly appreciate their kindness and the excellent service they provided during a stressful time.

reviews.author: matt joy
reviews.text: Sunflower did our driveway on our new property. They did an excellent job! I was impressed with the quality of the job!

reviews.author: Heather Wittum
reviews.text: The guys took great care in trying to mitigate the damage to our lawn.  My husband was very particular about his lawn, and he would have been proud of the work they did.  Very sweet and compassionate.  I am very pleased with their work.  God bless.  Heather Verbeck

reviews.author: Harold Forsythe
reviews.text: If I could give six stars, I would. We couldn't be happier with Sunflower Plumbing. I'm a contractor out of Wichita, KS. We hired Sunflower Plumbing & Reliable Dirtworks to install a couple of septic tanks on a project South of ElDorado. We ran into solid rock about 18" down. They didn't miss a beat, and jumped right in, and knocked this project out. They even pulled off their scope of work to help us out when we ran into the same rock. OUTSTANDING COMPANY!!!
